title: Customer-Pay Repairs Production and Release Standard: Ready Notice, Vehicle Release and Warranty Issue
content:
## Standard

The ready notice requires the post-repair scan where the tier runs a post-repair scan and, where the tier runs the calibration check, every calibration order linked to the repair order completed or its declination signed. Every calibration order linked to the repair order is completed or its declination is signed. A vehicle is released when the repair order balance is zero. An individual's balance is paid in full at release by one of the tier's accepted payment methods (financing only where financing is available in the tier and the balance is at least the tier's smallest financed balance); a fleet account's vehicle is released on its terms and its invoice is due within the tier's fleet payment terms in calendar days of delivery. Release issues the workmanship warranty plan the tier names.

This standard applies to Customer-Pay Repairs repair orders.

## Conditions as recorded

> Every calibration order linked to the repair order is completed or its declination is signed.

Applies to the ready notice. It is read from the ADAS Sensor Calibrations orders linked to this Customer-Pay Repairs repair order, each with its status, and from the declination form of each such order with the form's status, as the system shows them before the ready notice.

> A vehicle is released when the repair order balance is zero.

Applies to the release of the vehicle. It is read from this repair order's own ledger before release: the repair order balance is the charges and refunds booked to the order less the credits and payments booked to it.

## Stages

- **Ready**: final inspection is passed and the ready notice is sent; the order moves from in repair to ready and the ready date is recorded.
- **Delivered**: the vehicle is released to the customer; the order moves from ready to delivered, the delivered date is recorded and the warranty plan is issued.
- **Closed**: a delivered order closes when the repair order balance is zero.

## Calibration orders at the ready notice (hypothetical)

| Linked calibration order | Declination form | Order counts as |
|---|---|---|
| completed | - | settled for the ready notice |
| not completed | signed | settled for the ready notice |
| not completed | none, or not signed | not settled for the ready notice |

## Paying at release (hypothetical individual balances; a tier offering financing from 500.00)

| Balance due at release | Financing | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1200.00 | at least 500.00 | financing is one of the methods that may settle it |
| 450.00 | below 500.00 | financing may not be used; another accepted method settles it in full |
| any | tier without financing | settled in full by the tier's other accepted methods |

A fleet account's vehicle is released on its terms; with fleet terms of 30 calendar days and a hypothetical delivery on 2026-08-03, the fleet invoice is due within 30 calendar days of 2026-08-03.
